install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/npm-global/bin"; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/npm-global/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/npm-global/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/npm-global/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v http-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v htmlhint >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local/npm-global" --no-fund --no-audit http-server htmlhint; fi; for f in *.js; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then node --check "$f"; fi; done
